CLI not bundled. Gate-0: 0 hits, gap (existing Next.js template stops at Auth.js + shadcn, no typed API layer).

better-auth/better-auth (MIT, 28.7K stars, verified 2026-06-13). ABSORB -> references/auth-patterns.md: the self-hosted-library auth bucket (the middle path between managed SaaS and hand-rolling). Framework-agnostic TS auth that owns its own tables in YOUR DB, with 2FA + multi-tenant/org + plugins. Reach for it on data-residency/cost-constrained clients who can't use Clerk/Auth0. Still obeys never-build-auth (maintained library, not your code). Gate-0: 0 hits, gap (auth matrix was managed-provider-only).

Drizzle Kit migrations + Drizzle Studio noted. Gate-0: 1 thin mention ('Drizzle if Prisma perf issues') with no methodology; deepened, not a content-duplicate.
